verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Linear's own official MCP server at mcp.linear.app, which external agents connect to. That is the server role and does not show Linear can consume third-party MCP servers. Linear does ship its own agent (Linear Agent), so an MCP-client capability is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack shows users can plug external MCP servers into Linear or Linear Agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
